blocks.text: Grade 7 高频词汇 401–500
condemn /kən'dem/ v.t. 判刑, 责备, 谴责；[法] 定罪, 判刑, 宣告有罪
It claimed that God would condemn the leaders of the Court of Oyer and Terminer for putting innocent people to death.
中文语境：它声称上帝会谴责奥耶法院和特米纳法院的领导人杀害无辜者
positiveness n. 信心；肯定
Never before in my life did I ever see a man with such a sureness in his step, such power in his face, such friendly positiveness in his eye as when he smiled upon us.
中文语境：我一生中从来没有见过一个人，他的脚步如此坚定，他的脸上充满力量，他的眼神如此友好，积极，就像他对我们微笑时一样。 【07】从来不曾津津乐道仙力
chimera /kai'miərə/ n. 客迈拉(狮头、羊身、蛇尾的吐火女怪), 假想的妖怪, 妄想；[医] 嵌合体
I felt that the America that I sought was nothing but a shadow - an echo - a chimera of lunatics and crazy immigrants.
中文语境：我觉得我所寻求的美国只不过是一个影子--一个回声--一个疯子和疯狂移民的嵌合体
ruminant /'ruːminənt/ adj. 反刍类的, 沉思的, 默想的；n. 反刍动物
Fermentation in the guts of ruminant livestock - mostly cows - releases this gas.
中文语境：反刍牲畜（主要是牛）肠道内的发酵会释放这种气体
gram /græm/ n. 克, 绿豆, 鹰嘴豆；[医] 克

The diet of someone whose meals included an average of 50 to 99 grams (1.8 to 3.5 ounces) of meat each day would be responsible for the daily release of 5.6 kilograms (12.4 pounds) of CO 2 equivalents, according to the new analysis.
中文语境：根据新的分析，如果一个人每天的膳食平均包含 50 至 99 克（1.8 至 3.5 盎司）肉类，那么他的饮食将导致每天释放 5.6 公斤（12.4 磅）CO 2 当量
potent /'pəutnt/ adj. 有力的, 有说服力的, 有效的；[医] 有力的, 有性交能力的
As such, they are more potent, molecule for molecule, in warming Earth's atmosphere.
中文语境：因此，它们在使地球大气变暖方面更有效
boost /buːst/ n. 推进, 吹捧；v.t. 推进, 提高, 宣扬, 促进
It also includes the fertilizer and chemicals that boost plant growth and fight pests.
中文语境：它还包括促进植物生长和防治害虫的肥料和化学品
centripetal /sen'tripitəl/ adj. 向心的；[医] 向心的, 向中的, 求中的
But centripetal (Sen-TRIP-eh-tul) force also is at work.
中文语境：但向心力 (Sen-TRIP-eh-tul) 也在发挥作用
brake /breik/ n. 刹车, 阻碍, 丛林；v. 刹车
Curves tend to put the brakes on human runners.
中文语境：曲线往往会给人类跑步者带来刹车
compensate /'kɒmpenseit/ v. 偿还, 补偿, 付报酬
So they couldn't compensate as well for their artificial limb generating less force against the ground compared to a regular ankle.
中文语境：因此，与普通脚踝相比，他们无法补偿假肢对地面产生的力较小
disadvantage /.disəd'vɑːntidʒ/ n. 缺点, 不利, 坏处
Left-leg amputees therefore may be at a disadvantage, the data indicate.
中文语境：数据表明，左腿截肢者可能处于不利地位
wavelength /'weivleŋθ/ n. 波长；[化] 波长
CO2 absorbs some wavelengths of the infrared light now being radiated from Earth's surface.
中文语境：二氧化碳吸收地球表面辐射的某些波长的红外光
radiation /.reidi'eiʃən/ n. 辐射；[化] 放射
This infrared radiation goes in all directions - including back to Earth's surface.
中文语境：这种红外辐射向各个方向传播--包括返回地球表面
researcher /riː'səːtʃə/ n. 研究人员

Knowing this, the researchers could look at the wavelengths of infrared light and, like a fingerprint, link it to what share was from a CO2 buildup in the air, and what share was due to other things, such as water vapor.
中文语境：知道这一点后，研究人员可以观察红外光的波长，并像指纹一样，将其与空气中二氧化碳积聚的份额以及水蒸气等其他物质的份额联系起来
hindsight /'haindsait/ n. 枪的表尺, 事后聪明
This, what I will call a movement, it turned out in hindsight to be a movement.
中文语境：这，我称之为运动，事后证明它是一场运动
sundry /'sʌndri/ adj. 各式各样的；[经] 杂的, 各种, 各式各样的
We were, previously, in other parts of the store where we purchased items like toothpaste, notebook paper, other sundry items, without incident.
中文语境：此前，我们在商店的其他地方购买了牙膏、笔记本纸和其他杂货，没有发生任何事故
segment /'segmənt/ n. 片段, 部分, 分节, 段；v. 分割, 分裂；[计] 段
People from every segment of life.
中文语境：来自生活各个领域的人们
facade /fə'sɑːd/ n. 建筑物的正面, 外观, 表面
The woman next to her, the oldest resident in Woodside, praised our family for preserving the Tudor facade on our home.
中文语境：她旁边的那位女士是伍德赛德最年长的居民，她称赞我们家保留了都铎王朝的外观
finite /'fainait/ adj. 有限的, 有穷的, 限定的；n. 有限物
It's my turn to ask questions, so I say to her, "Do you ever dream of exploring our one finite world?
中文语境：轮到我提问了，所以我对她说："你有没有梦想过探索我们这个有限的世界？
architectural /.ɑːki'tektʃərəl/ adj. 有关建筑的, 建筑学的
a type of architectural design that was popular from 1890-1940 5.
中文语境：1890-1940年流行的一种建筑设计类型 5.
suburb /'sʌbəːb/ n. 市郊住宅区, 郊区, 边缘

The people I knew who had grown up in suburbs and summer homes bought my story, I suppose, because it was consistent with a narrative we'd all learned from the movies and the stories that charities told about city kids, especially ones like me, the ones who weren't white.
中文语境：我想，我认识的那些在郊区和避暑别墅长大的人都买了我的故事，因为它与我们从电影和慈善机构讲述的城市孩子的故事中学到的叙述一致，尤其是像我这样的非白人孩子
deprive /di'praiv/ v.t. 剥夺, 使丧失；[法] 剥夺, 剥夺, 夺去
Yes, I assured them, I had grown up deprived.
中文语境：是的，我向他们保证，我是在贫困中长大的
enshrine /in'ʃrain/ v.t. 入庙祀奉, 铭记
He was the first Latin American player enshrined as a Negro Leaguer in the National Baseball Hall of Fame in Cooperstown, New York.
中文语境：他是第一位被列为纽约库珀斯敦国家棒球名人堂的黑人联盟球员的拉丁美洲球员
multiple /'mʌltipl/ n. 倍数, 并联；adj. 多样的, 许多的, 多功能的
Cuban native José Méndez, considered one of the best pitchers of his era in any league, led the Kansas City Monarchs to multiple championships in the mid-1920s as the team's player-manager.
中文语境：古巴人何塞·门德斯 (José Méndez) 被认为是他那个时代在任何联盟中最好的投手之一，他在 20 年代中期作为球队的球员兼教练带领堪萨斯城君主队多次夺得冠军
secession /si'seʃən/ n. 脱离, 分离
Virginia seceded from the United States and joined the Confederacy rather than send volunteers to fight against "her sister states." Three other Southern slave states quickly moved toward secession.
中文语境：弗吉尼亚脱离美国并加入联邦，而不是派遣志愿者去对抗"她的姐妹州"。另外三个南方蓄奴州迅速走向分裂
bombardment /bɒm'bɑːdmənt/ n. 炮击；[化] 轰击
The bombardment of Fort Sumter was the first battle of the American Civil War.
中文语境：轰炸萨姆特堡是美国内战的第一场战役
fortress /'fɒːtris/ n. 城堡, 要塞；v.t. 筑要塞, 以要塞防守

For 34 hours, Confederate cannon fire from the shores of South Carolina's Charleston Harbor battered the towering walls of the island fortress as fiery shells crashed into the open area in its center.
中文语境：在长达 34 小时的时间里，南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿港沿岸的南方邦联炮火猛烈地袭击了岛屿堡垒的高耸墙壁，炽热的炮弹落入其中心的空地
harp /hɑːp/ n. 竖琴；v.i. 弹奏竖琴, 不停地说
Dad finally broke down and took us to East Boston Urban Center after Mom had been harping on it for the past two weeks.
中文语境：在妈妈喋喋不休两周后，爸爸终于崩溃了，带我们去了东波士顿市中心
laconic /lə'kɒnik/ adj. 简洁的, 简明的
Pittman started his testimony in a laconic and brusque manner.
中文语境：皮特曼以简洁而粗暴的方式开始了他的证词
brusque /brusk/ adj. 唐突的, 直率的
Pittman started his testimony in a laconic and brusque manner.
中文语境：皮特曼以简洁而粗暴的方式开始了他的证词
capsize /kæp'saiz/ v. 翻覆, 倾覆
Many of my passengers begged me not to do this, fearing that the boat would capsize.
中文语境：我的许多乘客恳求我不要这样做，担心船会倾覆
impart /im'pɑːt/ v.t. 给予, 传授, 告知
"If the Impart had been bow on," continued Pittman, "the Titanic would be afloat now.
中文语境："如果'Impart'号一直在船头，"皮特曼继续说道，"泰坦尼克号现在就会漂浮在水面上
bonanza /bəu'nænzə/ n. 富矿带, 带来好运的事物, 幸运

Since the discovery of gold by George Carmack on Bonanza Creek in September 1896, the growth of this country has been phenomenal, more especially so to one who has visited and is familiar with Dawson and the Klondyke mining section.
中文语境：自从 1896 年 9 月乔治·卡马克 (George Carmack) 在博南扎溪 (Bonanza Creek) 发现金矿以来，这个国家的发展是惊人的，对于曾经访问过并熟悉道森 (Dawson) 和克朗代克 (Klondyke) 矿区的人来说更是如此
gulch /gʌlʃ/ n. 地沟, 冲沟
On Skukum Gulch $30,000 were taken from two boxes of dirt.
中文语境：在 Skukum 峡谷，从两箱泥土中取出了 30,000 美元
locality /ləu'kæliti/ n. 地方, 所在, 位置；[法] 位置, 场所, 地区
In the meantime, men are sent to examine the locality and if anything of value is found, the man wishing to record the claim is told that it is already located.
中文语境：与此同时，人们被派去检查该地点，如果发现任何有价值的东西，希望记录索赔的人会被告知该物品已经找到
pan /pæn/ n. 平锅, 浅盘, 盆地, 硬土层, 拍摄全景；v. 上下左右移动, 摇镜头, 淘洗, 淘金
Charley Anderson, on Eldorado, panned out $700 in three hours.
中文语境：查理·安德森 (Charley Anderson) 在《埃尔多拉多》(Eldorado) 上三小时内赚到了 700 美元
phenomenal /fi'nɒminəl/ adj. 现象的, 能知觉的, 异常的, 显著的, 惊人的

Since the discovery of gold by George Carmack on Bonanza Creek in September 1896, the growth of this country has been phenomenal, more especially so to one who has visited and is familiar with Dawson and the Klondyke mining section.
中文语境：自从 1896 年 9 月乔治·卡马克 (George Carmack) 在博南扎溪 (Bonanza Creek) 发现金矿以来，这个国家的发展是惊人的，对于曾经访问过并熟悉道森 (Dawson) 和克朗代克 (Klondyke) 矿区的人来说更是如此
dysentery /'disəntəri/ n. 痢疾；[医] 痢疾
They were able to avoid getting dysentery, a disease that came from drinking river water contaminated by human waste.
中文语境：他们能够避免感染痢疾，这是一种因饮用被人类排泄物污染的河水而产生的疾病
transcontinental /'trænzkɔnti'nentəl/ adj. 横贯大陆的, 大陆那边的
The best answer was to build a transcontinental railroad.
中文语境：最好的答案是修建一条横贯大陆的铁路
contaminate /kən'tæmineit/ v.t. 弄污, 弄脏, 污染, 毒害；[化] 污染
They were able to avoid getting dysentery, a disease that came from drinking river water contaminated by human waste.
中文语境：他们能够避免感染痢疾，这是一种因饮用被人类排泄物污染的河水而产生的疾病
insignia /in'signiə/ n. 勋章, 徽章；[法] 勋章, 徽章, 荣誉

But within a short time, head artist Joe Shuster and his team began depicting Clark ripping open his shirt to reveal the "S" insignia on his chest - an image that became so popular that other superheroes would later copy the same type of transformations.
中文语境：但不久之后，首席艺术家乔·舒斯特（Joe Shuster）和他的团队开始描绘克拉克撕开衬衫，露出胸前的"S"徽章的形象--这一形象变得如此受欢迎，以至于其他超级英雄后来也效仿了同样类型的变形
introvert /'intrəuvəːt/ n. 个性内向者；v.t. 使内向, 使内弯, 内陷；v.i. 内省, 内弯；adj. 性格内向的
In order to make other people truly believe that he was a 2 3 "normal" civilian, Clark adopted a largely passive and introverted personality.
中文语境：为了让其他人真正相信他是一个 2 3 "正常"平民，克拉克采取了很大程度上被动和内向的性格
slouch /slautʃ/ n. 没精打采的样子, 耷拉, 笨人；v.i. 没精打采地走, 耷拉着；v.t. 使低垂
shy and quiet, especially in the presence of others conservative mannerisms, a higher-pitched voice, and a slight slouch.
中文语境：害羞、安静，尤其是在别人面前表现出保守的举止、声音较高、略显无精打采
passive /'pæsiv/ adj. 消极的, 被动的, 冷漠的, 顺从的, 无源的；[医] 被动的
In order to make other people truly believe that he was a 2 3 "normal" civilian, Clark adopted a largely passive and introverted personality.
中文语境：为了让其他人真正相信他是一个 2 3 "正常"平民，克拉克采取了很大程度上被动和内向的性格
suspect /sə'spekt/ n. 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯；adj. 令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的；v. 怀疑, 猜想

While the people in the city loved Superman, they assumed that he couldn't possibly have a secret identity because he didn't wear a mask, and thus very few people suspected that he and Clark could be the same person.
中文语境：虽然这座城市的人们喜爱超人，但他们认为他不可能有秘密身份，因为他没有戴面具，因此很少有人怀疑他和克拉克可能是同一个人
chastise /tʃæ'staiz/ v.t. 责骂, 惩罚；[法] 责罚, 惩戒, 严惩

Elliott would not allow brown-eyed and blue-eyed children to drink from the same water fountain, and often chastised the brown-eyed students when they did not follow the exercise's rules or made mistakes.
中文语境：艾略特不允许棕色眼睛和蓝眼睛的孩子从同一个饮水机喝水，并且经常在棕色眼睛的学生不遵守练习规则或犯错误时惩罚他们
subservient /səb'səːviənt/ adj. 有帮助的, 有用的, 奉承的
The "inferior" classmates also transformed - into timid and subservient children who even during recess isolated themselves, including those who had previously been dominant in the class.
中文语境："劣等"同学也变成了胆怯、顺从的孩子，甚至在课间休息时也孤立自己，包括那些以前在班上占主导地位的孩子
exemplify /ig'zemplifai/ v.t. 例证, 例示；[法] 制作经公章证明的誊本, 例证
She often exemplified the differences between the two groups by 1.
中文语境：她经常用1来举例说明两组之间的差异
arrogant /'ærəɡənt/ adj. 自大的, 傲慢的
Those who were deemed "superior" became arrogant, bossy, and otherwise unpleasant to their "inferior" classmates.
中文语境：那些被认为"优秀"的人变得傲慢、专横，并且在其他方面让他们的"低等"同学感到不愉快
taunt /tɒːnt/ n. 辱骂, 嘲弄；v.t. 嘲弄, 奚落；adj. 很高的
While the brown-eyed children did taunt the blue-eyed in ways similar to what had occurred the previous day, Elliott reports it was much less intense.
中文语境：虽然棕色眼睛的孩子确实以与前一天类似的方式嘲笑蓝眼睛的孩子，但埃利奥特报告说，程度要低得多
vandalism /'vændəlizm/ n. 故意毁坏文物的行为, 破坏他人财产的行为
Behaviors include brawling, vandalism, and intimidation.
中文语境：行为包括争吵、破坏公物和恐吓
opinionated /ə'pinjəneitid/ adj. 固执己见的, 武断的

But others condemned the piece: "By this example of opinionated, baseless reporting, Look itself pays scant recognition to the traditions of American Justice it claims were ignored," said one Mississippi reporter.
中文语境：但其他人谴责这篇文章："通过这种固执己见、毫无根据的报道，《Look》本身对其声称被忽视的美国司法传统缺乏认可，"密西西比州的一位记者说
baseless /'beislis/ adj. 无根据的

But others condemned the piece: "By this example of opinionated, baseless reporting, Look itself pays scant recognition to the traditions of American Justice it claims were ignored," said one Mississippi reporter.
中文语境：但其他人谴责这篇文章："通过这种固执己见、毫无根据的报道，《Look》本身对其声称被忽视的美国司法传统缺乏认可，"密西西比州的一位记者说
adverse /'ædvəːs/ adj. 不利的, 敌对的, 相反的, 逆的；[法] 相反的, 敌对的, 逆的
In 1956 he did not dominate the league as much as he used to, partially because of the adverse effects of the diabetes he suffered from.
中文语境：1956年，他不再像以前那样统治联盟，部分原因是他患有糖尿病的不利影响
dominate /'dɒmineit/ v. 支配, 占优势
In 1956 he did not dominate the league as much as he used to, partially because of the adverse effects of the diabetes he suffered from.
中文语境：1956年，他不再像以前那样统治联盟，部分原因是他患有糖尿病的不利影响
motto /'mɒtəu/ n. 箴言, 座右铭, 警句
Its motto is, "Equal Justice under the Law," because it aims to interpret the Constitution and settle debates between lawyers fairly.
中文语境：其座右铭是"法律面前人人平等"，因为它的目的是解释宪法并公平解决律师之间的争论
judicial /dʒuː'diʃəl/ adj. 法庭的, 公正的, 审判上的, 司法的；[法] 司法的, 审判上的, 法官的
The Constitution set up the Supreme Court to be the highest court in the land, and the head of the judicial branch of the government.
中文语境：宪法规定最高法院为全国最高法院，也是政府司法部门的负责人
verdict /'vəːdikt/ n. 裁决, 判决, 判断性意见, 定论, 结论；[法] 定论, 判断, 意见
If one side of a case that was tried in a lower court does not like the outcome of the verdict, they can appeal to a higher court and hope the decision will be different.
中文语境：如果下级法院审理的案件的一方不喜欢判决结果，他们可以向上级法院提出上诉，希望得到不同的判决
interpret /in'təːprit/ v.t. 解释, 演出, 翻译, 理解；v.i. 翻译, 解释
Its motto is, "Equal Justice under the Law," because it aims to interpret the Constitution and settle debates between lawyers fairly.
中文语境：其座右铭是"法律面前人人平等"，因为它的目的是解释宪法并公平解决律师之间的争论
initial /i'niʃəl/ n. 字首, 首字母；adj. 开始的, 最初的, 字首的；v.t. 用姓名的首字母签名
The Justices meet immediately after the hearing to discuss some initial thoughts, but they do not officially vote on the case until sometime later.
中文语境：法官们在听证会后立即开会讨论一些初步想法，但直到稍后他们才会正式对此案进行投票
application /.æpli'keiʃən/ n. 应用, 申请, 志愿书, 应用程序；[计] 应用, 应用程序
They get up to 8,000 applications every year from lawyers who want to appeal, but they only hear about 80 cases each year.
